lead: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy is best known as an Indian politician, born on 21 December 1972 in Pulivendula.
As of 2026, he is 53 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Y. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy was born on 21 December 1972 in Pulivendula, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Y. S. Rajasekhara Reddy and his mother, Y. S. Vijayamma.
He received his education at Hyderabad Public School and Nizam College.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu.

sections.heading: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy — Career and Professional Work
paras: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (2019–2024) and Member of the 15th Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with YSR Congress Party.

sections.heading: Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to YS Bharathi Reddy.
He is a parent to Harsha Reddy and Varsha Reddy.
He is associated with Hyderabad and Amaravati as a place of residence.
